Poland reports arrests of 2 Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with Starlink station fire last month
clusters.summary: Polish authorities have reported the arrests of two Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with alleged sabotage of a Starlink station last month. Prime Minister Donald Tusk called the fire an act of "hybrid warfare."

clusters.headline: Two high-ranking Iranian defectors give DW a rare look into the mindset of the regime's loyal servants
clusters.summary: Months of correspondence with two high-ranking defectors have given DW's investigative unit a rare look at the mindset of the regime's loyal servants — and revealed a clandestine circle that allegedly plots murders.

clusters.headline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ex-DR Congo President Kabila to Lead New 'Politico-Military' Alliance With M23 Rebels
clusters.summary: [RFI] Former Democratic Republic of Congo president Joseph Kabila has joined forces with the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group to lead a new political and military alliance, marking his most direct intervention yet in the conflict that has gripped the country's east.

clusters.headline: Critics warn of espionage risks as Slovakia restores military-diplomatic representation with Russia
clusters.summary: Slovakia is restoring military-diplomatic relations with Russia for the first time since 2022. The government has defended the move; critics warn of espionage risks and further damage to trust within NATO.

clusters.headline: South Africa: Police Call Sibiya's Exit 'Dishonourable' As He Quits Amid Disciplinary Proceedings
clusters.summary: [Scrolla] Sibiya's lawyer tendered his resignation straight after his disciplinary hearing began, and his employment ended immediately, police said.   Police say he had an ongoing disciplinary case when he resigned, so his exit counts as a dishonourable discharge.

clusters.headline: Business as usual for most patients as public healthcare clusters recover from 9-hour disruption
clusters.summary: Across seven healthcare institutions visited by CNA, most patients said they had few or no issues, despite signs warning visitors of potentially longer wait times.
